calque.description: Make a PDF or scan reusable in Word, simply and privately. Conversion stays in the browser, with two clear choices: keep the appearance of the pages or get text you can edit.
calque.alt: Illustration: a PDF page becomes a Word document, connected by an arrow.
calque.caption: From the source document to text you can work with.

coachos.description: Help design and communicate basketball plays: draw movements, organise a playbook, and present the game through animation. A personal tool for preparing sessions and sharing intentions with the team.
coachos.alt: Illustrative basketball diagram: three numbered players, movements and a pass on a court.
coachos.caption: Concept illustration · a play brought into motion.

eclipse.description: Build a 3D fantasy action adventure that runs in a browser on desktop and mobile. The prototype combines exploration, combat, and puzzles in a guided expedition through a world still under construction.
eclipse.alt: Mood illustration: a traveller follows a path towards an ancient gateway beneath an eclipse.
eclipse.caption: An interpretation of the world · illustration, not a game screenshot.
